text:
maria.docs: Heads-up: opened docs PR #913 to migrate the quota tier examples page from the old "tiered-plan" layout to the new "credits/throughput" model. Preview failed a few QA checks; posting context and checklist here.

jenna: thanks. what are the main copy changes?

maria.docs: summary: replace ambiguous "requests per minute" examples with concrete tokens/sec and burst-credit examples. Also swap the pricing table so it shows "effective unit cost" (cost per 1K tokens) instead of absolute monthly price — that aligns with the usage econ playbook.

omar: make sure you include a note about per-route quotas vs account-wide quotas. We keep seeing customers expect route quotas to cascade.

maria.docs: good call. added a short FAQ block: "Do route quotas reduce account quota?" answer: no, route quotas are enforced independently and don't consume account 'reserved' capacity unless configured.

luke: QAed the SDK snippets. Two small issues: Python example uses old client.create(...) signature; new SDK uses client.responses.create. Also the curl header still shows X-Api-Key.

kevin: dropping suggested replacements:
```python
# Python SDK — v2
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-medium", input="hello")
print(resp.output_text)
```

```bash
# curl example with bearer token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"hi"}'
```

jenna: also add a short code snippet for rate-limit handling (backoff + Retry-After) — support reported a few app bugs where clients interpret 429 as permanent.

maria.docs: added retry guidance and a compact JS snippet for exponential backoff.

maria.docs: I changed the dashboard link to point at panel id 322 (usage-by-team) but left a redirect for the old panel id 198 in _redirects. Example redirect added:```
#/docs/usage#by-team  /dashboards/usage?panelId=322  302
```

luke: tiny nit: redirects should be 301 for SEO. We generally use 301 unless it's temporary.

maria.docs: switched to 301. updated PR.

omar: CI preview looks good. One localization note: the French copy for the pricing table got clipped because translated strings were longer; layout overflows on mobile. Can we shorten headers or use responsive table stacking?

maria.docs: filed a small follow-up PR to the i18n team to update fr.json with shorter keys. For now, I added a CSS tweak to make the table stack on narrow screens.

kevin: are we also updating the sample billing calculation in the pricing guide? It still assumes old units.

maria.docs: yes — updated the calc snippet and added a live sample link to the calculator sandbox: https://calc.redwood.ai/?preset=quota-tier-v2

jenna: approving once samples and snippets are updated.

omar: LGTM. I'll run the analytics smoke tests against the preview to confirm panel traffic metrics still render.

deploybot: site deploy queued for branch docs/quota-tier-migration. build started at 2026-03-23T15:01:10Z.

deploybot: preview build succeeded — https://deploy-preview-913--docs.redwood.ai

maria.docs: merged. Thanks everyone — I'll send a short note to support and account management with the migration highlights and the redirect rules so they can patch customer docs. If any follow-ups crop up (fr layout or SDK nuance), I'll open a small patch PR. :)
